posts.author: jrburns47
posts.content_md: Nice find. Are they French? Have you gotten a quote on the 2 watt unit? The waveplates are airspaced which is good for high power lasers. If you’re looking for less expensive waveplates, [www.unionoptics.com](http://www.unionoptics.com) in China is a good source. They sell cemented, air spaced, and optically contacted.
